name: R: client reference images (2026-11-24)
character: Products chosen after the client reviewed their own style references (image23 kitchen, image12 bathroom): white Calacatta-gold-look slab for the kitchen, a light veined feature panel and floor and brass fittings for the ensuite. Look-alikes are CC0 render proxies.

items.use: Kitchen island worktop and waterfall ends, base-run worktops

product.name: GRANDE MARBLE LOOK CALACATTA VENA VECCHIA LUX RT 6,5MM

extra.listing_row: GRANDE MARBLE LOOK CALACATTA VENA VECCHIA LUX RT 6,5MM | Size: 160x320cm | Code: M7GF | Colorbody fine porcelain stoneware | Frost proof | Resistance deep abrasion | Thickness: MM 6,5

source.quote: Marble Look interprets the beauty of fine marbles in porcelain stoneware, turning it into large slabs that enhance depth and graphic richness.

egypt.gap: No Egypt distributor/showroom/dealer page found for Marazzi (searches and Marazzi where-to-buy URL guesses returned nothing); only a Dubai Marazzi Middle East showroom is reported. Confirm with Marazzi Middle East.

items.lookalike_note: Marble014 (ambientCG, CC0) is the nearest CC0 scan: cream marble with tan-brown veining. It is NOT the product: the maker's M7GF has bold gold-brown ribbons on white (image23, the client's kitchen reference, shows the same look); no CC0 scan with gold veining was found (ambientCG Marble001-025 checked), so the render's veining is paler and finer than the real slab.
